name: nudge
description: A live, conversational AI pair-programming tutor for DSA interview prep — watches your active file, talks through hints via voice or text, and adapts to what trips you up over time.

nudge.voice.description: Voice used by the spoken tutor (OpenAI Realtime API voice).

nudge.realtimeModel.markdownDescription: OpenAI Realtime API model id. Update this if OpenAI ships a newer realtime model.

nudge.idleThresholdSeconds.description: How many seconds of no typing in the watched file before Nudge proactively checks in.

nudge.maxContextChars.description: Max characters of the active file's content sent to the model as context (truncated around the cursor if the file is longer).

nudge.micDeviceIndex.description: avfoundation microphone device index (macOS). -1 means unset — Nudge will prompt you to pick one the first time you enable voice. Use 'Nudge: Select Microphone' to change it.

nudge.autoMuteDuringPlayback.description: Stop forwarding mic audio to the model while the tutor is speaking, so it can't pick up its own voice through your speakers and self-trigger an interruption. Turn this off only if you're on headphones (no speaker-to-mic path) and want to interrupt the tutor mid-sentence by voice.
